text.arabic_uthmani: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive connective opening a new evidentiary branch inside the ongoing warning discourse
words.prose: The opening {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) resumes the warning sequence and makes the ʿAd case a linked evidentiary branch, not detached historical color. Its payoff is discourse placement: the named people enter as the next case in an argument already underway.

topics.headline: resumptive case-frame opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as continuation and case-framing, not as an isolated story.
topics.reason: The particle stands before the topic-setting frame and the attachment evidence reads the opening as a resumed contrastive sequence.

words.gloss_range: topic-partition particle that sets up a required answer and classifies the ʿAd case
words.prose: {{ar:أَمَّا}} ({{tr:ammā}}) partitions the discourse and projects an answer, so the following arrogance is not loosely appended. The particle formally turns ʿAd into a judged case whose predicate must arrive.

topics.headline: partition with required answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle sorts ʿAd into a formal case panel whose answer is their arrogance.
topics.reason: Local grammar identifies the particle as a topic-setting form requiring a following answer with fa.

words.gloss_range: proper people-name functioning as a nominative collective case topic; root recurrence remains background only
words.root_gloss_range: return, recurrence, and restoration range; locally the surface is a proper people-name, so etymological return pressure is secondary.
words.prose: {{ar:عَادٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿādun}}) names the people as the formal topic of the case. The singular name behaves collectively through later plural actions, while the root’s return range must stay secondary to the proper-name function. The memory of ʿAd as a power case (89:6-8) sharpens why this branch turns on strength.

topics.headline: named collective case topic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a singular people-name organizes the whole chain of arrogance, boast, failed recognition, and denial as one collective profile.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word a nominative proper topic, and the later plural predicates treat the people as a collective actor.

topics.headline: proper name over root recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps any return-coloring subordinate to the local proper-name role rather than turning the name into etymological allegory.
topics.reason: The root has return and recurrence range, but the local form is a proper noun and the grammar selects people-name reference.

topics.headline: power memory of the ʿAd case
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the strength-boast against ʿAd’s remembered monumental power (89:6-8), making the rebuttal historically focused.
topics.reason: The concrete cross-reference presents ʿAd as a marked power case, and the local ayah makes strength the diagnostic failure.

words.gloss_range: answer-marker after the topic partition, locking the predicate to the named case
words.prose: The second {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the answer-marker the partition requires. It removes delay between the case-name and the verdict: ʿAd is introduced and immediately defined by its arrogance.

topics.headline: required answer marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar locks arrogance to the ʿAd case instead of presenting it as a loose next event.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies this particle as the answer fa after the topic-setting particle.

words.gloss_range: Form X plural perfect naming a completed collective posture of self-magnifying arrogance without right
words.root_gloss_range: greatness, largeness, seniority, and arrogance range; Form X locally selects self-magnifying arrogance rather than legitimate greatness.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:istakbarū}}) presents arrogance as a completed collective stance. Its Form X shape makes greatness something claimed or sought, and the surrounding domain and rightlessness frame that self-enlargement before the boast speaks. The same arrogance field becomes refusal-speech in messenger scenes (7:75), so the strength boast is a recognizable pattern of status inflation speaking against evidence.

topics.headline: completed collective arrogance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices arrogance as a whole people’s established posture, framed by arena and moral mode before any quote appears.
topics.reason: The verb is a perfect plural and is intransitive here, with domain and manner complements supplying scope and moral evaluation.

topics.headline: Form X self-claimed greatness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the issue is not strength itself but self-manufactured superiority without warrant.
topics.reason: The root can mark real greatness, but Form X plus the rightlessness qualifier selects wrongful self-magnification.

topics.headline: arrogance as refusal engine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the boast to a wider refusal pattern: arrogance becomes speech against evidence, as in the messenger-refusal pattern (7:75).
topics.reason: The row evidence links arrogance with speech and rejection scenes, while local sequence moves from posture to quoted boast.

words.gloss_range: preposition locating arrogance inside an arena or domain
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) attaches the arrogance to an arena. The diagnosis begins by localizing power in the land or worldly domain before judging its moral mode.

topics.headline: arena of arrogance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the staged diagnosis: first the sphere of power, then the moral qualifier.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the preposition govern the land noun as the local domain complement.

words.gloss_range: definite earth or land as the known created arena in which their dominance occurs
words.root_gloss_range: earth, land, ground, and territory range; locally the definite noun marks the known created arena of the arrogance.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) is the definite land or earth, the recognized arena inside which ʿAd magnifies itself. The local range can hold territory and earth together, but both readings confine their boast within created space, with the surah’s creation discourse in view (41:9-12). Because the land phrase comes before the quote, the ayah frames the arena of power before letting the boast articulate its logic.

topics.headline: definite created arena
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their territorial arrogance is placed inside a known created arena, not a world of their own making.
topics.reason: The noun is definite after the preposition, and contextual rows connect the land/earth range to creation discourse in the surah.

topics.headline: domain before quotation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah frames the sphere of arrogance before allowing the power boast to articulate itself.
topics.reason: The phrase precedes the quoted speech and participates in the local movement from arena to moral qualification.

words.gloss_range: preposition making rightlessness the manner and accompaniment of arrogance
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the absence of right to the arrogance itself. That makes the coming boast enter through an already moralized manner phrase rather than as a neutral comparison.

topics.headline: rightlessness as manner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the arrogance is characterized by lack of right before the quoted claim is heard.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the exclusion phrase and functions locally as manner or accompanying state.

words.gloss_range: construct noun of exclusion, removing the act from the known category of right
words.root_gloss_range: otherness, difference, exclusion, and negation range; locally construct use makes an exclusion from right.
words.prose: {{ar:غَيْرِ}} ({{tr:ghayri}}) works as a negative hinge: it governs the right-standard and excludes ʿAd’s arrogance from it. Because this qualifier stands before the quote, their strength question is heard as unauthorized from the start, and the missing right anticipates the denied signs at the close. The same arrogance-without-right chain is tied to turning from signs in 7:146, matching the ayah’s move from rightlessness to sign-denial.

topics.headline: exclusion from right
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase does more than say different; it removes the boast from legitimate right.
topics.reason: The construct governs the definite right-standard and creates an exclusion phrase, supported by local grammar and lexical range.

topics.headline: qualifier preframes the quote
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the quoted power claim only after narrator judgment has already marked it as unauthorized.
topics.reason: The word sits between the arrogance report and the speech report, structurally controlling the audience’s hearing of the quote.

topics.headline: rightlessness anticipates sign-denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah framed by rejected right at the front and rejected signs at the end, with 7:146 giving a close arrogance-without-right and sign-refusal parallel.
topics.reason: Concrete intertext and local structure connect absence of right to later sign-denial.

words.gloss_range: definite truth/right standard that denies factual grounding and rightful authorization to the arrogance
words.root_gloss_range: truth, reality, due right, firm establishment, and entitlement range; locally it supplies the standard their arrogance lacks.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَقِّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqi}}) supplies the standard by which the boast is judged before it is quoted. Its local range joins truth, reality, due right, and authorization, so force is measured against right rather than treated as self-justifying. Against the wider truth-over-falsehood horizon (17:81), 41:15 shows force cut loose from right becoming self-deception.

topics.headline: definite truth-right standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah invokes a recognized standard of truth and right, not a tribal preference.
topics.reason: The word is definite and governed as the complement of the exclusion phrase, while lexical evidence joins truth and due right.

topics.headline: verdict before quotation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the boast under a prior moral verdict rather than as an open question about capability.
topics.reason: The qualifier occurs before the speech verb, so the quote enters an already evaluated frame.

topics.headline: truth standard over force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that force severed from truth becomes self-deception; 17:81 supplies a broader truth-over-falsehood horizon.
topics.reason: Intertext and collocation rows connect the truth field to speech, creation, and force.

words.gloss_range: conjunction linking arrogance to the speech that exposes it
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the report from inner posture to voiced claim. The boast is therefore not a separate anecdote; it is what the arrogance sounds like when it speaks. This first conjunction opens voiced power logic, while the later final conjunction opens habitual denial, creating a frame from speech to state.

topics.headline: arrogance becomes speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quoted boast is an extension of the arrogance, not a disconnected statement.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the speech verb with the preceding arrogance clause.

topics.headline: two conjunctions frame speech and diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first conjunction opening voiced power logic and the later conjunction opening habitual denial.
topics.reason: The row compares the local conjunction with the final conjunction, both framing the ayah’s movement.

words.gloss_range: plural speech verb introducing direct quoted content as self-incriminating evidence
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speech, assertion, and reported utterance range; locally it introduces their quoted boast as evidence.
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) lets ʿAd’s own wording enter the record. The speech verb externalizes arrogance as a public proposition, so the later rebuttal can answer the exact comparative logic rather than a paraphrase. Speech becomes a moral site in the surah: this arrogant saying contrasts with steadfast confession (41:30), and the strength boast makes explicit the power-controlled refusal already staged in 41:14.

topics.headline: direct quote as evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah preserves the boast in direct speech so it can be rebutted on its own terms.
topics.reason: The verb introduces the interrogative quote as its content, and discourse rows show the quote preparing the counter-question.

topics.headline: speech as moral site
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees speech itself as morally diagnostic: the same speech field can voice arrogance here and steadfast confession later (41:30).
topics.reason: Surah-local and intertext rows contrast arrogant qawl with faithful speech and other self-sufficiency claims.

topics.headline: power-based refusal made explicit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the strength-boast as the explicit form of a refusal logic already active in the preceding scene (41:14).
topics.reason: Boundary rows tie the quoted strength criterion to the previous demand and to the quote architecture.

words.gloss_range: interrogative pronoun functioning as the subject of a rhetorical comparative challenge
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the quote as a search for an outranking agent. Its breadth makes the boast feel universal: the speakers imply that no possible answer will exceed them.

topics.headline: rhetorical search for superior agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the question is a challenge form, not an innocent request for information.
topics.reason: The pronoun occupies the subject slot of the elative clause, and pragmatic rows identify the interrogative as boastful rhetoric.

topics.headline: ranked-agent opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears agent-ranking as the first element of the quote, before strength is even named.
topics.reason: The word opens the direct quote and sets up the comparison field.

words.gloss_range: first elative of intensity, setting ʿAd’s comparative scale of force
words.root_gloss_range: tightness, intensity, firmness, strength, and severity range; locally the elative selects comparative force.
words.prose: {{ar:أَشَدُّ}} ({{tr:ashaddu}}) turns the quote into a ranked scale of intensity. The root’s force, firmness, and severity range makes the boast more than muscle, while the elative form invites the later mirrored reversal. The hard doubled sound gives the boast audible weight, and earlier-power warnings (40:21; 89:6) plus later punitive severity (41:27) keep this comparative force field from sounding generic.

topics.headline: first comparative force scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ʿAd chooses a comparative scale, giving the rebuttal a grammar to reuse.
topics.reason: The word is an elative predicate in the quoted question and is paired locally with the force specification.

topics.headline: intensity and severity pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the boast as coercive intensity and severity, not just abstract strength.
topics.reason: Lexical rows give the root range of tightness, firmness, and severity; sound rows reinforce the tightened surface.

topics.headline: mirrored comparative reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first comparative as the setup for the second: the ayah defeats the boast by retaining its comparative grammar.
topics.reason: Local repetition and collocation evidence show the same elative and force metric returning in the rebuttal.

topics.headline: historical power setting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears ʿAd’s claim within the memory of exceptional earlier power (40:21; 89:6), while 41:27 later turns intensity into punishment vocabulary.
topics.reason: Concrete references connect the local force term to warning and punitive intensity contexts.

words.gloss_range: comparative prepositional phrase making the speakers their own benchmark
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَّا}} ({{tr:minnā}}) makes the speakers the comparison baseline. The self-centered suffix is later answered by a third-person benchmark, removing their control over the scale they tried to set.

topics.headline: speakers as benchmark
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that arrogance begins by choosing the self as the measure of power.
topics.reason: The preposition plus first-person plural suffix supplies the comparison complement to the first elative.

topics.headline: first person to third person reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the rebuttal strip the speakers of evaluative authority by turning their first-person benchmark into third-person assessment.
topics.reason: The local comparative frame repeats with a changed pronoun, converting their self-measure into external measurement.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative specification fixing the boast’s metric as force or capacity
words.root_gloss_range: strength, capacity, force, and capability range; locally the noun names the metric first boasted in and then reassigned to the Creator.
words.prose: {{ar:قُوَّةً}} ({{tr:quwwatan}}) closes the quoted boast with force as its chosen metric. The noun’s capacity range is not denied, but the structure later reclassifies that force as created and turns the same metric against the speakers. The contrast with commanded prepared strength (8:60) sharpens the local misuse: here force is detached from right and treated as self-authorizing.

topics.headline: force as specified metric
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that superiority is narrowed to force or capacity, not left as vague greatness.
topics.reason: The noun is an accusative specification after the elative, with lexical range covering strength, force, and capacity.

topics.headline: boasted force as created capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees real capacity being misread as self-grounding; the later creation proof makes it derivative.
topics.reason: The local boast uses the force noun, but the subsequent creation clause limits its autonomy rather than denying its reality.

topics.headline: metric seized by rebuttal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact reprise: the value that closes the boast becomes the value by which the boast is overturned.
topics.reason: The same strength noun recurs in the mirrored comparison, and discourse rows identify it as the axis of reversal.

words.gloss_range: compound interrogative-connective pivot introducing the narrator’s rebuking counter-question
words.prose: {{ar:أَوَ}} ({{tr:a-wa}}) pivots from ʿAd’s quoted question to the narrator’s stronger question. It connects the rebuttal to the boast while marking a change of voice and authority.

topics.headline: pivot to rebuking counter-question
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the immediate shift from boastful human question to narrator rebuke.
topics.reason: The compound opens the negated perception clause after the quote, and discourse rows identify it as the hinge into rebuttal.

topics.headline: connection without voice flattening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears both continuity and interruption: the rebuttal answers the quote but does not share its voice.
topics.reason: The connective element links clauses while the interrogative opening creates the audible and discourse break.

words.gloss_range: negating particle governing a jussive imperfect with past-time failed recognition force
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) makes the following perception verb a past-negated failure. In the rebuking question, the issue is not missing data but an already failed recognition of the Creator-strength relation.

topics.headline: past-negated recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rebuttal charges an already failed inference, not a neutral present uncertainty.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following imperfect, giving jussive form and past negation.

topics.headline: negation inside rebuke
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the negation as part of a cognition trial: the embedded proof is what they should have grasped.
topics.reason: With the interrogative pivot, the negation intensifies rebuke and prepares the content clause.

words.gloss_range: jussive plural perception verb selecting cognitive recognition of the following proposition
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, considering, and judging range; locally the clausal object selects cognitive recognition.
words.prose: {{ar:يَرَوْا۟}} ({{tr:yaraw}}) means more than looking here because it governs a proposition. The charge is failed recognition: after boasting about force, they should have grasped the Creator premise that overturns their measure. Its jussive plural surface after negation makes the failed recognition grammatically visible, and the surah’s later promise of clarifying signs (41:53) shows what such seeing should have yielded before the ending hardens into sign-denial.

topics.headline: seeing as recognition of a proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failure is intellectual and evidentiary, not merely visual.
topics.reason: The verb is jussive after negation and takes the following content clause, selecting recognition of a proposition.

topics.headline: jussive morphology visible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees negated recognition marked on the word’s surface through the plural jussive form.
topics.reason: Morphological rows identify the lam-governed jussive and loss of final nun.

topics.headline: from boast to proof clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the second half as an epistemic correction that turns the boast into a proof challenge.
topics.reason: Discourse rows show the verb opening the narrator-led proof frame after the quoted boast.

topics.headline: failed seeing hardens into denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects failed recognition to later sign-denial; 41:53 promises signs that clarify truth while this ayah shows refusal to infer.
topics.reason: Surah-local rows connect seeing, signs, earth, and the final denial.

words.gloss_range: assertive content-clause marker packaging the creator-strength proposition as what they failed to recognize
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) turns the following structure into the content of failed recognition. The rebuttal is therefore a complete proposition: named Creator, creation relation, focus pronoun, and mirrored comparison.

topics.headline: embedded rebuttal proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the answer to the boast is packaged as one proposition they should have recognized.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the content complement of the perception verb and encloses the full creator-strength reversal.

topics.headline: assertive embedded claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the embedded claim as established content, not tentative speculation.
topics.reason: The particle carries assertive force inside the cognition clause.

words.gloss_range: divine proper name as the accusative subject of the embedded rebuttal proposition, identified through creation
words.root_gloss_range: deity, worship, devotion, and the divine-name field; locally the proper name is identified through creation before the comparison.
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) enters as the subject of the proposition ʿAd failed to recognize. The name is not a generic stronger rival; the following creator relation grounds why the comparison must be reversed. Devotion-name background remains subordinate to that creator proof, and the same creator formula later becomes worship logic (41:37), linking the final sign-denial to named divine authority.

topics.headline: divine name as proposition subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the counter-comparison is anchored in the named divine subject, not an unnamed rival power.
topics.reason: QAC and grammar make the name the accusative subject of the embedded content clause.

topics.headline: name specified by creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees superior force grounded in origination before the predicate arrives.
topics.reason: The divine name is immediately modified by the relative creator clause, making creation the explanatory basis.

topics.headline: derivational dispute subordinate to proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may retain devotion-name background, but the local argument is resolved by creation rather than by etymological speculation.
topics.reason: Lexical dispute rows are valid background, while the local relative clause supplies the controlling proof.

topics.headline: divine authority behind denied signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader links the final sign-denial to the divine authority established in the proposition, with 41:37 extending the creator formula into worship logic.
topics.reason: Intertext and cooccurrence rows connect the divine name, creation, worship logic, and final denial.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun attaching the creation clause to the divine name as evidence before the predicate
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) makes creation an attributive clause of the divine name, not a detached fact. Its placement delays the comparison so the reason for superiority is heard before the verdict lands.

topics.headline: relative clause as evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that creation is grammatically tied to the divine name as the relevant evidence.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun modifies the divine name and opens the creation clause.

topics.headline: creation before predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the reason for divine superiority before the comparison itself arrives.
topics.reason: The relative clause intervenes between subject and predicate, making creation the syntactic hinge.

words.gloss_range: perfect creation verb with object suffix making the boasters themselves created and measured
words.root_gloss_range: creating, originating, shaping, and measuring range; locally the perfect verb makes the boasters themselves created objects.
words.prose: {{ar:خَلَقَهُمْ}} ({{tr:khalaqahum}}) is the pivot of the rebuttal. The same people who spoke as self-measuring subjects become the created object and then the exceeded benchmark, so their force is included inside what the Creator formed and measured. Other creator proofs sharpen the move: 36:81 argues from creation to power, and 41:21 later repeats creation as courtroom proof.

topics.headline: boasters as created object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ʿAd themselves become the evidence against their self-measure.
topics.reason: The perfect verb marks completed creation and the object suffix identifies the boasters as what was created.

topics.headline: origination and measured forming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees their strength as part of a formed constitution, not an independent source of proof.
topics.reason: Root evidence includes creating and proportioning, and the local verb-plus-suffix compresses creator and object relation.

topics.headline: createdness before strength predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the comparison become an argument from origin rather than a bare ranking.
topics.reason: The creation verb is inserted before the focus pronoun and comparative predicate.

topics.headline: object suffix returns as benchmark
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the role reversal: the group moves from self-asserting subject to created object to exceeded benchmark.
topics.reason: The suffix links the created object to the later comparison complement.

topics.headline: creator proof against power claims
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places the argument beside other creator proofs: 36:81 argues from creation to power, and 41:21 later repeats creation as courtroom proof.
topics.reason: Concrete references support the creator-proof logic without replacing the local syntax.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun focusing the predicate on the divine subject after the relative clause
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) recenters the proposition after the creation clause. As a separator or emphatic pronoun, it keeps the superior-force predicate anchored to the Creator and displaces ʿAd’s self-center.

topics.headline: separator and focus pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the predicate is focused back onto the divine subject after the intervening creator clause.
topics.reason: The pronoun agrees with the divine subject and can function as separator or emphasis before the predicate.

topics.headline: pivot from creation to verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees creation evidence converted into the comparison verdict in one compact movement.
topics.reason: The pronoun stands between the creation clause and the elative predicate.

topics.headline: divine focus replaces self-center
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the scale recentered from ʿAd’s first-person boast to the divine subject before they become the exceeded party.
topics.reason: Discourse rows contrast the pronoun with the earlier first-person benchmark.

words.gloss_range: second elative of intensity, now predicating divine superiority in the same force scale
words.root_gloss_range: tightness, intensity, firmness, strength, and severity range; locally the elative selects comparative force.
words.prose: {{ar:أَشَدُّ}} ({{tr:ashaddu}}) repeats the comparative scale under a new owner. What was boastful ranking in ʿAd’s mouth becomes asserted superiority after creation evidence, with intensity vocabulary later available for punishment language (41:27). The repeated hard comparative sound audibly mirrors and overpowers the first claim rather than merely changing the subject.

topics.headline: divine comparative predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same comparative form now belongs to the Creator, not to the boasters.
topics.reason: The word is the predicate of the embedded clause after the focus pronoun.

topics.headline: same scale reassigned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah keep the original scale while changing its grammatical owner.
topics.reason: Local repetition of the elative makes the rebuttal a reversal rather than a new topic.

topics.headline: severity pressure in divine rebuttal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears superior power with severity pressure, a field that later reappears in punitive intensity (41:27) and warning over stronger peoples (40:82).
topics.reason: Root and intertext rows connect strength, severity, and later punishment vocabulary.

topics.headline: audible mirrored force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the repeated hard comparative sound as the rebuttal mirrors and overpowers the first claim.
topics.reason: Sound and repetition rows support an audible reprise of the first elative.

words.gloss_range: comparative complement making ʿAd the third-person exceeded benchmark
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُمْ}} ({{tr:minhum}}) supplies the new benchmark. The first-person self-measure has become third-person assessment, so ʿAd are now objects within the comparison they tried to control.

topics.headline: ʿAd as exceeded benchmark
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rebuttal measures ʿAd from outside rather than letting them define the scale.
topics.reason: The preposition plus third-person plural suffix completes the comparison complement to the second elative.

topics.headline: pronoun reversal removes authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees their speaking authority removed as first person becomes third person in the same comparative frame.
topics.reason: Discourse rows identify the pronoun shift as a role movement from evaluator to evaluated.

words.gloss_range: second indefinite accusative specification, preserving the force metric while subordinating it to creation
words.root_gloss_range: strength, capacity, force, and capability range; locally the noun names the metric first boasted in and then reassigned to the Creator.
words.prose: {{ar:قُوَّةًۭ}} ({{tr:quwwatan}}) completes the mirrored rebuttal on the same metric that closed the boast. After createdness, force no longer sounds autonomous; it names a created capacity exceeded by its source. The divine-power field is not abstract here: divine might named elsewhere (22:40) is narratively proven against human force, and the rebuttal closes by re-owning their metric.

topics.headline: second force specification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exact measure-for-measure reversal: the same force noun completes both boast and rebuttal.
topics.reason: The noun again functions as accusative specification after the elative in the repeated comparative frame.

topics.headline: force reread after creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees power reclassified as endowed capacity, not independent force.
topics.reason: The preceding creation verb makes the force field derivative from the Creator in local sequence.

topics.headline: divine power association
topics.reader_payoff: The reader links the force term to the divine-power field; 22:40 names divine might while 41:15 narratively proves it against human force.
topics.reason: Intertext and cooccurrence rows connect the force noun to divine power language.

topics.headline: rebuttal closes on seized metric
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the rebuttal end by re-owning the very value that ended the boast.
topics.reason: The word closes the comparison clause and repeats the earlier collocation.

words.gloss_range: conjunction introducing the final diagnostic habitual-state clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the final diagnosis after the creator-strength proof. The ending turns from comparison to persistent denial, explaining why the proof did not correct them.

topics.headline: final diagnostic link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause is not an afterthought but a diagnosis connected to the failed recognition.
topics.reason: The conjunction links the proof clause to the habitual denial clause.

topics.headline: from proof to denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah close not on superior force alone but on the epistemic refusal that sustains the boast.
topics.reason: Discourse rows identify the movement from rebuking question to diagnostic statement.

words.gloss_range: plural auxiliary forming a habitual state of ongoing denial with the following imperfect
words.root_gloss_range: being, becoming, existing, and remaining range; locally the auxiliary makes denial a settled historical state.
words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) makes denial a settled state, not a single missed inference. The auxiliary turns the final verb into a historical posture, so the power boast becomes one symptom of persistent refusal. In the surah-local pattern, this habit becomes stated punishment cause (41:28), while being-language later frames the promise to the steadfast (41:30).

topics.headline: habitual denial state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial is portrayed as ongoing practice rather than a momentary mistake.
topics.reason: The auxiliary plus imperfect construction gives durative habitual force.

topics.headline: denial as historical posture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees refusal as a state that explains why the creator proof did not transform them.
topics.reason: Lexical and grammar rows turn the denial verb from an event into a characterized being-state.

topics.headline: surah-local state contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this negative persistence beside nearby surah patterns: 41:28 repeats the cause, while 41:30 uses being-language in promise for the steadfast.
topics.reason: Concrete same-surah references connect this auxiliary to punishment cause and steadfast promise.

topics.headline: auxiliary reframes the boast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the mirrored comparison reinterpreted as part of a durable identity-state of sign refusal.
topics.reason: The closing construction binds being-state to active refusal and fronted signs.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the divine signs as the governed target of repudiation and foregrounding that object before the verb
words.prose: {{ar:بِـ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the signs as the object-domain of denial. Because the prepositional object comes before the final verb, the rejected evidence is foregrounded before the act of repudiation lands.

topics.headline: target of repudiation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial is directed at divine signs, not left objectless or vague.
topics.reason: The preposition attaches the signs to the denial verb as its governed target.

topics.headline: fronted object before final verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the evidence placed in focus before the final act of denial is named.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase precedes the final verb in the closing clause.

words.gloss_range: plural possessed divine signs, proofs, and revealed indicators as the focused object of denial
words.root_gloss_range: sign, mark, proof, and revealed indicator range, with a noted derivational dispute; locally the plural possessive marks divine evidence.
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتِنَا}} ({{tr:āyātinā}}) names the rejected evidence as God’s own signs. The plural gathers modes of evidence, and the possessive suffix makes denial more than generic skepticism: it refuses indicators that should have drawn recognition back to the Creator. Fronting makes the signs the final clause’s focal object before denial lands, explaining why the earlier failed-seeing question is rebuke; 41:53 promises clarifying signs, and 41:28 returns sign-denial as punishment cause.

topics.headline: divine-owned evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial targets God’s own indicators, not neutral data detached from the speaker.
topics.reason: The possessed plural carries the first-person suffix and is governed as the object-domain of denial.

topics.headline: signs, proofs, and revealed units
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial cover the broader evidentiary field, not one medium alone.
topics.reason: Lexical rows support sign, proof, wonder, and revealed-unit range, while plural form gathers multiple modes.

topics.headline: derivational return-pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may hear the signs as indicators that should draw recognition back to the Creator, while local sense remains signs or proofs.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is useful as pressure but does not replace the selected signs/proofs sense.

topics.headline: fronted final object focus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rejected evidence placed before the final denial verb, so denial is judged by what it refuses.
topics.reason: The phrase is genitive after the preposition but semantically the object of denial and appears before the final verb.

topics.headline: surah-local sign spine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the closure to the surah’s sign logic: 41:53 promises clarifying signs, while 41:28 returns sign-denial as punishment cause.
topics.reason: Concrete same-surah rows connect signs with truth clarification and repeated denial.

topics.headline: signs answer failed seeing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the earlier failed-seeing question is rebuke: signs are what should have been seen or inferred.
topics.reason: The rows connect the object of denial to the earlier perception failure and to the repeated sign-denial phrase (41:28).

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect naming ongoing culpable repudiation of available signs
words.root_gloss_range: denial, repudiation, and refusal to acknowledge a known or available truth range; locally the imperfect marks ongoing sign-denial.
words.prose: {{ar:يَجْحَدُونَ}} ({{tr:yajḥadūn}}) seals the ayah on active denial. Under the preceding auxiliary, the imperfect makes repudiation ongoing; lexically it is refusal to acknowledge available evidence, so failed seeing hardens into sign-denial. The final position makes denial the last diagnostic word, and the same sign-denial logic returns as punishment cause (41:28), while 29:49 marks such denial as the act of wrongdoers.

topics.headline: ongoing active repudiation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices denial as repeated active practice, not a sudden identity label or single lapse.
topics.reason: The imperfect under the auxiliary gives repeated present-in-the-past force, and Form I keeps the action active.

topics.headline: denial against available recognition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the close as blame-laden refusal to acknowledge evidence, not mere ignorance.
topics.reason: The root range often implies denial of what is recognizable, and the local sequence has already rebuked failed recognition.

topics.headline: false measurement ends as sign denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that mismeasuring power is bound to refusing signs and divine authority.
topics.reason: The final verb follows the creator-strength correction and takes the divine signs as its object-domain.

topics.headline: final diagnostic word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears denial as the last diagnostic word after arrogance, boast, creation, and signs have all been staged.
topics.reason: The verb occupies final position and the row evidence notes the marked concentration of the denial root.

topics.headline: sign-denial as later punishment cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the ending to later and wider sign-denial logic: 41:28 repeats it as punishment cause, and 29:49 restricts denial of signs to wrongdoers.
topics.reason: Concrete references and local movement connect failed seeing to denial and later punishment explanation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ ... مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً
baseline_models.mechanism: Aad convert a real concentration of force into self-authorizing rank. The sequence joins self-enlargement, occupation of the earthly field, exclusion of right, and a comparative challenge, so possession of power is made to certify entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Self-exaltation supplies the upward claim by which Aad enlarge their rank.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the bounded field in which their elevation is asserted.
Exclusion and negation remove right from the asserted elevation.
Fixed obligation and entitlement supply the norm that force cannot manufacture.
Hard intensity supplies the repeated comparative scale on which Aad place themselves and their Creator.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies the collective capacity claimed by 'us.'

changed_reading.before: Aad are generally arrogant because they are powerful.
changed_reading.after: Aad commit a political and moral category error: they turn concentrated capacity into a warrant for rank even though the verse expressly severs their elevation from right.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً ... يَجْحَدُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The creator-created relation is presented as evidence available to sight or reflection. Because their own force is an effect of creation, its existence is already evidence against autonomy; final denial makes the failure a contradiction of recognized signs rather than a lack of data.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight supplies the demanded apprehension of their dependence.
Creative origination makes Aad and their capacity effects rather than independent sources.
Visible signs supply the evidentiary field in which createdness can be recognized.
Denial of what is known turns the missed inference into suppression rather than simple ignorance.

changed_reading.before: The verse answers a boast by naming a stronger opponent.
changed_reading.after: The answer is internal to Aad's own power: the fact that created strength exists visibly identifies a prior source, so their boast uses the evidence of dependence to deny dependence.

baseline_models.mechanism: The utterance is not merely reported speech. It installs a creed and a contest in which Aad choose the unit, nominate themselves as the maximum, and let victory stand in for truth. The divine reply repeats their own comparative terms while restoring reality to the measure.

activation_trace.role: Speech as belief and doctrine makes the boast an organizing worldview, not an isolated sentence.
Competitive overpowering supplies the contest structure built into their self-description.
Reality matching truth supplies the standard displaced by their self-chosen comparison.
Knowing denial explains how the spoken scale can be maintained against contrary evidence.

changed_reading.before: Their question expresses confidence in military superiority.
changed_reading.after: Their question is a speech-act of counter-measurement: it creates a closed contest whose metric makes force its own proof and whose conclusion is protected by denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence places detailed signs before a response architecture of turning sideways, refusing responsive hearing, covering the heart, weighting the ear, and erecting a barrier. Aad's failure to see in 41:15 is therefore sharpened into maintained insulation from already articulated evidence.

activation_trace.role: Knowing denial anchors the contextual barrier mechanism in the focus ayah.
Detail that exposes parts and meanings supplies evidence that is already made discriminable.
Turning one's side away supplies the first bodily act of disengagement.
Hearing as understanding and compliance shows that the refused operation is responsive uptake, not sound alone.
Protective covering supplies the enclosure claimed around the heart.
Weight in the ear supplies a load that prevents evidence from becoming understanding.
Blocked access supplies the declared separation between claimant and messenger.

structural_cues: 41:3-5 moves from signs made detailed to turning away, non-hearing, and a first-person inventory of coverings and barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarified signs and the audience's own barrier language; I infer a maintained refusal-system from the progression and active turning. A live alternative is that the sensory images describe experienced incapacity rather than deliberate construction.

changed_reading.before: Aad simply fail to notice that their Creator is stronger.
changed_reading.after: Their nonseeing belongs to a reproducible denial technology: clarified evidence is kept from uptake by bodily, affective, and relational barriers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before Aad make themselves the maximum, the surah presents earth's provisions as measured, heaven and earth as answering a command, and the completed order as the determination of the Mighty and Knowing. Their force is no free-standing quantity; it is a bounded allocation inside an ordered field they did not set.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and proportioning in creation anchors the claim that Aad's capacity has a set measure.
Gathered strands of strength supply the bounded capacity whose source and limit are at issue.
Deliberate apportionment supplies an ordered measure for earthly provision.
Obedient yielding supplies the relation of the vast created domains to command.
Overpowering might names the agency that completes and governs the measured order.

structural_cues: 41:9-12 precedes the focus with creation, provisioning, command, willing or unwilling compliance, completion, and divine determination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, command, compliance, and might; I infer that human capacity is delegated and bounded within that order. The live alternative is a simpler display of greater divine power without a governance model for Aad's strength.

changed_reading.before: The verse compares two quantities of force and declares God's larger.
changed_reading.after: The comparison exposes a jurisdictional absurdity: Aad rank an allocated capacity against the very agency that measures the field, gives domains their order, and can command them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus images strength as gathered strands, while its immediate consequence arrives as moving air: diffuse, penetrating, and ungraspable. Concentrated collective force is defeated by a medium it cannot hold, converting public superiority into exposure and abasement.

activation_trace.role: Rope-like gathered strands supply the image of Aad's concentrated and mutually reinforcing power.
Wind and moving air supply a distributed force that enters rather than confronts as another solid body.
A bitterly cold roaring wind intensifies the atmospheric instrument that reverses their power claim.
Humiliation, exposure, and exclusion supply the social reversal of their self-exaltation.

structural_cues: 41:16 begins with a consequential 'so We sent' immediately after the boast and names wind as the instrument.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathered strength, wind, and humiliation; I supply the concentrated-versus-distributed material contrast. A live alternative is that wind only demonstrates divine scale and carries no critique of how Aad organize force.

changed_reading.before: Their superior force is overcome by an even stronger external force.
changed_reading.after: Their model of strength is materially reversed: tightly accumulated power proves vulnerable to an ambient force that cannot be monopolized, faced, or counted as one more rival body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired Thamud panel explicitly places guidance before a preference for blindness. That sequence supplies a motivational grammar for Aad's 'did they not see': nonseeing can be loved, selected, and used to preserve a desired power arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Reflective judgment supplies the faculty whose nonuse requires explanation.
Denial with knowledge anchors the proposal that perception is subordinated to preference.
Gentle indication toward truth supplies the available path that precedes refusal.
Love adhering to the heart supplies the preference binding the subject to blindness.
Blindness of inner perception supplies the chosen condition, beyond loss of physical sight.
Intentional choosing makes the preference mechanism explicit at the branch-image level.

structural_cues: The adjacent narratives are paired by 'as for Aad' in 41:15 and 'as for Thamud' in 41:17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit preference for blindness in the paired community; I transfer that motivational possibility to Aad's failed seeing. The live alternative is that Thamud's preference diagnoses only Thamud and should not specify Aad's motive.

changed_reading.before: Aad overlook an obvious inference because arrogance clouds judgment.
changed_reading.after: Aad's nonseeing can function as a valued choice: blindness protects the self-ranking they prefer, while denial is the operation that keeps contrary knowledge from changing it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later relocates evidence into hearing, sight, and skin, which testify about what their owners did. The focus denial is thus unstable at the level of the body: the apparatus used to screen signs remains an evidentiary surface and cannot finally be recruited into silence.

activation_trace.role: Manifest signs anchor the evidence that Aad attempt to deny.
Testimony that clarifies from knowledge supplies the body's counter-speech.
The body's outer covering becomes an intimate record rather than a controllable boundary.
Uncertain supposition supplies the false concealment model behind their conduct.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the divine knowledge their concealment model underestimates.

structural_cues: 41:20 lists hearing, sights, and skins as witnesses; 41:22 explains concealment through the thought that God did not know much of their action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies embodied testimony and the mistaken supposition about knowledge; I read the future testimony as a retrospective diagnosis of focus-ayah denial. A live alternative is that this scene concerns accountability only and does not explain the earlier perceptual failure.

changed_reading.before: Aad reject signs located outside themselves.
changed_reading.after: Their denial tries to control perception while their own perceptual and bodily surfaces remain signs and eventual witnesses, making the refusal internally unsustainable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later collective refusal is engineered through attached companions who beautify a temporal field and through coordinated noise intended to prevail over recitation. This activates the plural 'from us' in Aad's boast: social strength can consist in controlling what a group can hear and making mutual reinforcement feel like proof.

activation_trace.role: Speech spreading among people anchors the boast as a social circulation, not private cognition.
Strength gathered in strands supplies the image of mutually reinforcing members.
A companion bound to a companion supplies the social linkage that stabilizes a shared view.
Making something appear attractive supplies the reframing that protects the group's temporal story.
Mixed loud noise supplies active interference with hearing the recitation.
Force that conquers supplies the stated objective of the noise tactic.

structural_cues: 41:25 joins companions with beautification of what lies before and behind; 41:26 turns non-hearing into an imperative and links noise directly to prevailing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies linked companions, beautification, coordinated noise, and the aim of prevailing; I connect that apparatus to Aad's first-person plural and gathered strength. A live alternative is that the later tactic belongs to a different rejecting community and should not be projected historically onto Aad.

changed_reading.before: The plural boast reports the combined physical strength of a people.
changed_reading.after: The plural can also name an epistemic force formation: linked speakers amplify one another, suppress rival speech, and then mistake the resulting consensus for superiority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later pairs another collective declaration with standing straight, then places human arrogance against tireless glorification by those near the Lord. Speech joined to aligned persistence becomes the counter-form of strength, while self-enlargement is shown to be unnecessary to the order it refuses.

activation_trace.role: Gathered capacity anchors the question of what makes a collective genuinely strong.
Speech as conviction supplies a declaration ordered toward the Lord rather than toward the group's own maximum.
Straightness, balance, and alignment supply a durable posture after the declaration.
The repeated self-exaltation root directly reopens Aad's posture later in the surah.
Continuous declaring free of defect supplies an ordered practice that does not depend on arrogant participants.

structural_cues: 41:30 has 'they said ... then stood straight'; 41:38 has 'if they act arrogantly' followed by uninterrupted glorification near the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two speech-posture pairings and a direct recurrence of arrogance; I infer a revaluation of strength from dominance to aligned persistence. A live alternative is that the passages contrast worship responses without redefining qūwa.

changed_reading.before: Strength is the greatest capacity to overpower another party.
changed_reading.after: The surah offers a rival collective strength: speech aligned to its source and sustained in upright action, while arrogant force merely excludes its holder from an order that continues without it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Aad exalt themselves in the earth, but the surah later makes earth itself low and still, then receptive to descending water, after which it moves and rises. The material sequence suggests that legitimate elevation is received through responsive lowliness, reversing Aad's attempt to rise by self-assertion.

activation_trace.role: Self-produced elevation supplies the human posture to be reversed.
Earth as the lower domain anchors the contextual material analogy directly in the focus location.
Low, dormant earth supplies a receptive posture rather than a self-elevating one.
Delivery from above supplies the enabling input that the earth does not generate for itself.
Earth and vegetation stirring with life supplies the first consequence of reception.
Increase and rising supply an elevation caused by received life rather than seized rank.

structural_cues: The temporal hinge in 41:39 runs from earth seen as humbled to water sent down, then movement and rising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a physical sequence of lowliness, reception, movement, and increase; I analogize it to the moral posture of humans 'in the earth.' The live alternative, and the primary local function, is a demonstration of resurrection with no social model of elevation.

changed_reading.before: Earth is simply the territory across which Aad behave arrogantly.
changed_reading.after: Earth becomes a counter-teacher inside the verse: its real rising follows receptive lowliness, exposing Aad's self-exaltation as an attempt to invert the material grammar of life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's later justice axiom blocks a crude reading in which God defeats Aad merely because a stronger party defines right. The focus already marks Aad's elevation as without right; 41:46 binds consequence to each agent's deed and denies that the Lord withholds or displaces anyone's right.

activation_trace.role: Truth fixed against falsehood supplies a norm independent of comparative force.
Repeated intensity anchors the risk that the reply could be reduced to greater might.
Withholding and confinement away from right supplies the injustice explicitly denied of the Lord.

structural_cues: 41:46 balances good for oneself and harm against oneself before denying injustice toward servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus-ayah 'without right' and a later denial of divine injustice; I infer that greater divine strength executes rather than creates the moral distinction. A live alternative is that 41:46 concerns individual judgment without qualifying the force comparison in 41:15.

changed_reading.before: Aad's might claim fails because God is the stronger claimant.
changed_reading.after: Aad fail because they sever might from right; divine superiority does not ratify that equation, since the surah separately binds divine action to non-injustice and deeds to their agents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creator's strength is later displayed not as a larger finished body but as complete governance of hidden emergence: fruit leaves its sheath and pregnancy passes from inner carrying to birth only within divine knowledge. This revises the focus comparison from visible output to generative power over concealed transitions.

activation_trace.role: Creative origination anchors the later hidden processes in the focus description of God.
Visible or insightful seeing anchors the contrast between finished visible force and concealed formation.
Complete disclosure to the knower supplies governance across concealed and manifest stages.
A plant vessel enclosing fruit supplies the hidden chamber from which formed life emerges.
Inner carrying and fruit supply a generative capacity invisible during development.
Laying down a pregnancy in birth supplies the transition from concealed potential to manifest life.

structural_cues: 41:47 couples knowledge of the Hour with fruit exiting sheaths and every carrying and birth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine knowledge across hidden biological transitions; I treat such knowledge as active generative governance and contrast it with Aad's visible force metric. A live alternative is that the verse proves omniscience only, without specifying a mode of strength.

changed_reading.before: The Creator is stronger because He can produce a more overwhelming force.
changed_reading.after: Creative strength includes intimate command of formation, timing, enclosure, and emergence, a generative register that Aad's comparison of finished collective force cannot measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late human portrait alternates harm, mercy, self-attributing speech, side-turning, and urgent prayer. It reframes Aad's 'who is stronger than us' as a prosperity-conditioned ownership claim: favorable capacity is called intrinsically ours, while a touch of loss immediately reveals dependence.

activation_trace.role: Gathered capacity anchors the favorable condition appropriated as 'ours.'
Entitlement supplies the missing warrant that prosperous self-attribution pretends to establish.
Mercy and tenderness supply the favorable condition received from beyond the self.
Loss opposed to benefit supplies the prior condition that exposes contingency.
Speech as conviction turns received relief into the doctrine 'this is mine.'
Good condition and gift supply the state in which the human turns away.
Withdrawing by one's side supplies the bodily performance of self-sufficiency.
The mere arrival of an adverse effect supplies the small perturbation that reverses self-sufficiency into prolonged appeal.

structural_cues: 41:50 moves from adversity through received mercy to 'this is mine'; 41:51 moves from blessing and side-turning to an adverse touch and extended prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a generic human cycle of received benefit, ownership speech, withdrawal, and renewed dependence; I read Aad's boast as a collective instance of that cycle. A live alternative is that the late singular portrait and the historical people should remain distinct diagnoses.

changed_reading.before: Aad formulate a stable doctrine from an objective assessment of their force.
changed_reading.after: Their doctrine is affectively state-dependent: strength enjoyed as gift is relabeled inherent possession, and the imagined autonomy lasts only while adverse contact is absent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close reprises consideration, showing, signs, truth, and sufficiency, then extends evidence through horizons and selves before ending in complete encompassment. Aad's local 'earth' and collective 'us' are not a rival scale beside God; they are regions inside the evidentiary and cognitive scope they deny.

activation_trace.role: Knowing denial anchors the final expansion as an answer to the focus refusal.
Reality matching truth anchors the right that Aad exclude from their self-elevation.
The formula of consideration and inquiry directly reprises the focus demand to see.
Manifest signs supply the same denied evidence now distributed across scales.
Distant horizons expand the evidentiary field beyond Aad's occupied territory.
Emergence into clarity supplies the endpoint toward which the distributed signs work.
Sufficiency in carrying an affair supplies a witness that needs no rival power to complete its proof.
Complete cognitive and possessive encompassment supplies the final scale containing every local claimant.

structural_cues: 41:52-54 clusters 'have you considered,' 'We will show them,' 'Our signs,' 'the horizons,' 'within themselves,' 'becomes clear,' 'the truth,' sufficient witness, and encompassment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies strong lexical reprise and widening scope; I infer that the ending revises the focus comparative into a containment relation. A live alternative is that the closing verses validate revelation generally without specifically correcting Aad's metric.

changed_reading.before: God and Aad occupy the same scale, with God ranked higher in strength.
changed_reading.after: The surah's closing scope makes the comparison itself inadequate: Aad's land, bodies, and force lie inside an encompassing field of sign, witness, and knowledge, so the supposed rival is contained by the reality it contests.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant ع د د mapping from the proper name Aad and must not be rendered as the name's etymology. It remains anchored to word 2 and gains local relevance from the immediate plural comparison of strength; downstream prose should present it only as a split-root resonance in which counting, prepared resources, and peer comparison shadow the civilization's power metric.

activation_trace.role: Counting and aggregating supplies an exploratory resonance for a people who define strength through the collective 'us.'
Prepared stores, equipment, and readiness supply a possible material underside of their confidence.
A peer counted against another supplies the comparative logic of 'who is stronger than us.'
Bundled force supplies the focus mechanism to which counting and readiness attach.

changed_reading.before: Aad is only the historical label of the speaking people.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root activation, the name can faintly resonate with a regime that counts bodies, prepares assets, and compares peers, then mistakes aggregated readiness for ultimate strength.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق ل ل mapping for qālū and crosses from speech into load-bearing motion. It remains anchored to the utterance beside istakbarū and 'in the earth'; downstream prose should qualify it as a branch-image analogy, not a lexical translation of qālū.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ... وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا

activation_trace.role: Lifting and independently carrying a load supplies the exploratory image of speech hoisting the group's status.
Self-exaltation supplies the upward motion that the boast attempts to perform.
The lower earthly field supplies the ground from which their speech tries to lift them.

changed_reading.before: The boast verbally reports an already existing high rank.
changed_reading.after: In this contained image, the boast is a self-hoisting operation: speech tries to bear the collective upward and make the claimed elevation exist by saying it.

strongest_changes: Aad's force is an allocated capacity inside a measured and obedient created order, not an independent quantity that can authorize itself.
Failure to see becomes an engineered and preferred refusal system, later exposed by bodily witnesses and socially amplified noise.
Wind and the humbled, reviving earth reverse Aad's material grammar of power: distributed force and receptive generation defeat concentrated self-elevation.
Upright persistence supplies an alternative collective strength, while the justice axiom prevents divine superiority from collapsing into might-makes-right.
The final horizon-self-encompassment sequence turns a same-scale comparison into containment of Aad, their territory, and their evidence-denying faculties.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence changed the focus from a simple contest of magnitudes into linked political, epistemic, material, social, ecological, legal, and generative mechanisms. The packet's split mappings also preserved two branch-distant speech and naming resonances without treating them as lexical meanings.
remaining_uncertainties: The paired Thamud narrative and the later generic human portrait may illuminate Aad structurally without transferring every motive historically.
The rope-and-wind contrast and the earth's receptive rising are branch-guided material analogies, not explicit causal glosses.
Knowledge of hidden biological transitions may indicate omniscience without necessarily redefining strength as generative governance.
The two split-root outliers must remain qualified resonances rather than etymologies or translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Collective cohesion mistaken for ultimate strength.** **ك ب ر B006** gives self-magnification, **ش د د B002** intensity and hardness, and **ق و ي B001** assembled strength like rope-strands. Their boast is grammatically collective. I infer that social strands reinforce one another until cohesion is misread as independence from the one who proportioned them (**خ ل ق B001/B002**). The ayah exposes strength as assembled and derivative.
2. **Denial after sight, not ignorance before it.** **ر ء ي B001** supplies sight or insight, **ء ي ي B003** visible sign, and **ج ح د B001** knowing denial. The rhetorical question about seeing precedes the report of rejection. I infer that perception supplied enough recognition for denial to become active suppression. The ayah reads as a conflict between acknowledged evidence and defended status.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:20–23 later literalizes this inner conflict: sensory faculties testify while false supposition destroys its holder. 41:53 expands visible signs across horizons and selves, making the boast's field of evidence still more encompassing.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Derivative strength mistakes itself for autonomous strength.** Lexically, `ك ب ر B006` is self-magnifying refusal, `ق و ي B001` strength assembled like rope strands, `ش د د B002` intensified hardness, and `خ ل ق B002` bringing into being. Structurally, the exact comparative `أشد...قوة` is spoken first by the created group and then returned against them by reference to their Creator; 41:16 answers with moving air rather than a rival army. I assign their strength the role of assembled, dependent capacity and creation the role of its prior source. The abductive move is that what is assembled and originated cannot ground an absolute superiority claim. The boast reads as a category error about borrowed capacity.

2. **Denial despite perception.** `ر ء ي B001` supplies sensory or insightful seeing, `ء ي ي B003` visible signs, and `ج ح د B001` knowing denial. Their claim is interrupted by “did they not see,” and denial closes the ayah. I assign sight the role of available corrective evidence and `جحد` the role of suppressing what that evidence establishes. The ayah therefore distinguishes willful denial from informational ignorance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:16’s wind was the surprising correction to the strength contest: the response does not imitate their concentrated force but makes ambient air overpower it. 41:20’s bodily testimony also returned “did they not see” as an evidentiary failure inside their own sensorium.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyden ayrıldıktan sonra ona dönmeyi temel alır; yeniden yapma, yeniden yaptırma, tekrarlayan soru, hastalığın nüksetmesi ve daha önce yenmiş yemeğin yeniden sunulması bu çekirdeğin biçim ve kullanım uzantılarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yerleşik alışkanlığı değil, ayrılış ya da bir başlangıç sonrasında gerçekleşen dönüşü ve yinelemeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dönüş çekirdeğini korur; ettirgen, isteme bildiren ve kalıplaşmış kullanımları bu çekirdeğe bağlı ayrı gerçekleşmeler olarak sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerden, nesneden ya da işten ayrıldıktan sonra ona geri yönelmek veya başlanmış bir şeyi bir kez daha yapmak; türemiş biçimlerde bir başkasına yeniden yaptırmak ya da tekrar istemektir.

facets.statement: Ayrılınan bir şeye geri gelme ve başlangıçtan sonra aynı işe yeniden yönelme çekirdektir.
Bir işi yinelemek, bir başkasına yineletmek veya ondan yeniden yapmasını istemek dönüş çekirdeğinin eylemsel uzantılarıdır.
Bir topluluğun yeniden çatışmaya girmesi, ateşin nüksetmesi, sorunun tekrarlanması ve yemeğin yeniden sunulması özel kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak ekseni, ayrılıştan sonra geri gelme ile bir başlangıçtan sonra aynı eylemi yinelemedir; ettirgen ve isteme bildiren biçimler de bu eksene bağlanır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal doğuştan veya fiziksel nedenle konuşamama durumunu adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tekrarlanan eylemin kolaylaşarak yerleşmesini temel alır; alışma, alıştırma, sürekli uygulama, deneyimden doğan yeterlik ve çiftleşmeye alıştırılmış erkek hayvan bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tek seferlik geri dönüş bu dala girmez; yinelemenin alışkanlık, yatkınlık, deneyim veya kolaylık üretmesi gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın alışkanlık alanını, türemiş alışma ve alıştırma biçimlerini ve yalnız verilen hayvan tamlamasına bağlı özel kullanımı ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir eylemi tekrar tekrar yaparak onu kolay, yerleşik bir davranış veya yatkınlık hâline getirmek; bu yolla süreklilik, deneyim ve yapabilme gücü kazanmaktır.

facets.statement: Tekrarlanan eylemin kolaylaşıp yerleşik davranış veya yaradılış niteliği kazanması çekirdektir.
Bir şeye alışmak, bir canlıyı alıştırmak ve sürekli uygulama yoluyla yeterlik kazanmak bu çekirdeğin süreç uzantılarıdır.
Bir işi defalarca deneyen kişi ile çiftleşmeye defalarca katılmış erkek hayvan, edinilmiş deneyimin özel nitelemeleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, tekrarın eylemi kolaylaştırıp alışkanlığa dönüştürmesini ortak çekirdek sayar; süreklilik, beceri ve deneyim bildiren nitelemeler buna bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Tekrarın davranışı yerleştirdiği, kolaylaştırdığı ve deneyime dayalı yeterlik oluşturduğu bütün çekirdek alanı kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Tekrar, yerleşme, kolaylık ve yatkınlık bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir davranışın tekrar sayesinde kişide yerleşmesi bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tekrarla yerleşen davranış çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Başkasını alıştırma ve deneyime dayalı yeterlik nitelemelerini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir canlıya tekrarlı uygulamayla davranış veya beceri kazandırma bağlamına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tekrar yoluyla yatkınlık kazandırma sürecini korur.
error_profile.loses: Öznenin kendi alışkanlığını ve yerleşik davranış adını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aynı işe defalarca girişerek onu yapabilir hâle gelmiş kişi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tekrardan doğan deneyim ve yapabilme gücünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel alışkanlık sürecini ve hayvana ilişkin özel kullanımı dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tekrarın özne üzerinde oluşturduğu alışma ve kolaylığı öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise süregelen hâlin kendisini adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal tekrarın sonunda yerleşen alışkanlık ve yatkınlığı da sonuç olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal canlıyı eğitim ve egzersizle yumuşatıp becerikli hâle getirme sürecini merkezleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda amaçlı eğitim süreci belirleyicidir; odakta eğitim şart değildir ve kendiliğinden yerleşen alışkanlık da çekirdeğe girer.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العادة، والاعتياد، والتعود، والدربة حتى تصير سجية، والمواظبة، ومعاودة الحرب، والفحل المعتاد للضراب، والمطيق للشيء لأنه اعتاده.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو رجوعا عارضا مرة واحدة، ولا عيد الاجتماع، ولا عيادة المريض.
branches.source_phrase_ar: العادة الدربة والتمادي في شيء حتى يصير له سجية (maqayis;ayn)؛ المواظب على الشيء المعاود (maqayis;ayn)؛ بطل معاود (maqayis;ayn)؛ العادة معروفة والجمع عاد وعادات (sihah)؛ عاده واعتاده وتعوده (sihah)؛ عود كلبه الصيد فتعوده (sihah)؛ فلان معيد لهذا الأمر أي مطيق له (sihah;ayn)؛ المعيد الفحل الذي قد ضرب في الإبل مرات (sihah)؛ العادة اسم لتكرير الفعل والانفعال حتى يصير ذلك سهلا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı ziyaret kullanımını destekler: hastayı ziyaret etmek ve bir felaket ya da yas dolayısıyla insanların bir haneye tekrar tekrar gelmesi. Bunlar genel ziyaret değil, dönüş fikriyle sözlüksel olarak sınırlandırılmış yapılardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her türlü ziyaret veya bakım hizmetini değil, hasta ziyareti ile felaket ya da yas dolayısıyla gidilen özel ziyaret ortamını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım hasta ziyareti tamlamasını, ziyaretçi adlarını ve yas veya felaket ziyaretini bildiren özel biçimi birbirine karıştırmadan korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir hastayı ziyaret etmek veya bir felaket ya da yas dolayısıyla insanların aynı haneye gidip gelmesi; türemiş adlarda bu ziyaretçiler ya da ziyaret edilen acı olay da anlatılır.

facets.statement: Hastaya giderek onu ziyaret etmek dalın başlıca sözlüksel gerçekleşmesidir.
Hasta ziyaretini yapan erkek ve kadın toplulukları ayrı ad biçimleriyle gösterilir.
Bir felaket veya yas sebebiyle insanların uğradığı hane ve olay, tekrarlanan ziyaret ilişkisi üzerinden adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hasta ziyaretini ortak çekirdek olarak verir ve aynı dönüşlü ziyaret fikrini felaket ya da yas sebebiyle insanların uğradığı eve ve olaya genişletir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hasta ziyaretini ve insanların felaket ya da yas dolayısıyla bir haneye gidip gelmesini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: İki özel ziyaret alanını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hastanın yanına gidip onu görme bağlamındaki temel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hastayı ziyaret etme çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Felaket veya yas dolayısıyla yapılan ziyaret uzantısını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların bir felaket veya yas sebebiyle aynı haneye uğraması bağlamıyla sınırlıdır.

error_profile.loses: Hasta ziyaretini ve hasta ziyaretçilerini dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişiye geri dönen iyilik, bağış, şefkat, yarar veya kolaylığı çekirdek yapar; ayrıca bir iyiliğin ardından daha fazlasını sunma ve bir seçeneğin daha yararlı olması kullanımlarını destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal fiziksel dönüşü değil, bir yarar veya iyiliğin alıcıya ulaşmasını ve onun lehine sonuç doğurmasını anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yarar ve iyilik adını korur; karşılaştırmalı yararlılık ile iyiliği artırma söyleyişlerini ayrı sözlüksel uzantılar olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye iyilik, bağış, şefkat, yarar veya kolaylık olarak ulaşan ve onun lehine sonuç veren şey; türemiş yapılarda daha yararlı olma ya da yapılan iyiliği artırma anlamıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye ulaşan iyilik, bağış, şefkat veya yarar temel anlamı oluşturur.
Bir seçeneğin kişi için başka bir seçenekten daha yararlı veya daha elverişli olması karşılaştırmalı uzantıdır.
Bir kimsenin yaptığı iyiliğin ardından daha fazlasını sunması art arda iyilik bildiren özel kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar alıcıya ulaşan yarar, bağış, şefkat ve kolaylığı ortaklaştırır; daha yararlı olma ile iyiliği artırma bu sonuç ilişkisinin özel kullanımlarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yarar, bağış, şefkat ve kolaylığın alıcı lehine sonuçlanmasını birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yararın kişiye ulaşması ve iyilik niteliğini korur.
